notes: Stories created for EVAL-WEIGHTS with full coverage: schema, logic, API/UI, integration, tests.

stories.title: Define Weighting Schema and Persistence Contract
stories.description: Define data model for user-specific measure weights including defaults, normalization rules, and storage schema. Establish contract for how weights map to scoring inputs for both provider and clinical trial scoring engines.
stories.evidence: GAP: No weighting or preference persistence system exists; schema must be created for user-defined weights and mapping to scoring inputs

stories.title: Implement Weighted Scoring Adjustment Logic
stories.description: Build core logic to apply user-defined weights to underlying quality measures and recalculate composite scores deterministically for providers and clinical trials.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/application/facades/evaluate_care_facade.py (existing scoring flow to extend) + GAP: no weighting logic currently applied

stories.title: Expose Weight Configuration API and UI Controls
stories.description: Create backend endpoints to save/retrieve user weights and frontend controls (sliders or inputs) to adjust measure importance. Ensure immediate feedback loop triggers score recalculation.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend/src/components/ChatWindow.tsx (UI extension point) + GAP: no existing preference UI or API endpoints

stories.title: Integrate Weighting into Evaluate Care Facade Flow
stories.description: Modify evaluate_care_facade to incorporate user weights into scoring requests and ensure consistent behavior across provider and clinical trial evaluation paths.

stories.title: Weighting Logic Unit and Integration Test Suite
stories.description: Develop tests validating weight normalization, score recalculation accuracy, persistence, and end-to-end flow from UI input to updated scores.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/tests/ (existing testing patterns) + GAP: no tests for weighting behavior
